title: 塔貝拉水壩~Tarbela Dam
focus: 以塔貝拉深厚地基防滲及既有水路擴建界面學習~Studying Tarbela foundation seepage control and existing-waterway expansion interfaces
summary: 本課以以塔貝拉深厚地基防滲及既有水路擴建界面學習為主線，先用大體積填築物流與鋪蓋延伸與流路界定水力與構造條件，再將蓄水分期與孔壓、進水口餘隙與淤積連結到出口消能與修復證據。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops studying Tarbela foundation seepage control and existing-waterway expansion interfaces through Bulk placement logistics and Blanket extension and seepage paths, then connects Impoundment stages and pore pressure and Intake clearance and deposition to Outlet dissipation and repair evidence. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 塔貝拉壩位於巴基斯坦印度河，業主資料將其列為土石壩，世界銀行原始計畫資料記載壩工程於1976年完成。後續擴建利用既有水路增加發電功能，使地基防滲、泥砂淤積與改接水路成為同一系統的長期課題。本課區分原壩完工與2012年第四擴建批准，不把批准日期當成機組投入運轉日期，也不採內文不一致的早期機組加總。1986年原始評估用作工程脈絡，全部算例仍是獨立假想模型，並不重現壩基剖面或現行調度。~Tarbela stands on the Indus in Pakistan. Owner information identifies an embankment dam, and World Bank project records give1976 completion. Later generation extensions make foundation seepage, sedimentation and waterway conversion linked long-term issues. The course distinguishes original completion from approval of the fourth extension in2012; approval is not commissioning. Inconsistent early unit arithmetic is excluded. The1986 project audit supplies context, while all calculations remain hypothetical rather than reconstructions of foundation sections or present operations.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查大體積填築物流：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day；再獨立檢查鋪蓋延伸與流路：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。敏感度：同滲透係數與面積下，示意水路長度由400增至600m，達西流量減至三分之二；鋪蓋延長的真實效果需二維或三維流網，不能用此比例直接估算實際壩基改善。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 將比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Bulk placement logistics: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. Independently examine Blanket extension and seepage paths: k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s. Sensitivity: at fixed conductivity and area, increasing an illustrative seepage path from400 to600m reduces Darcy flow to two-thirds. Real blanket extension requires a two- or three-dimensional flow model rather than direct use of this ratio. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Use the following independent check: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 大體積填築物流~Bulk placement logistics
units.title: 大體積填築物流~Bulk placement logistics
units.mechanism: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。理想車隊算例假設供料與攤鋪不成瓶頸，實際還需檢查材料分區、道路干擾與品質驗收速度，不能只加車就宣稱產能增加。 驗證時應核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，並辨識以下失效情境：把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. Truck payload, cycle time and productive hours limit output. An ideal fleet estimate assumes loading and spreading are unconstrained; material zoning, road interference and acceptance capacity can become bottlenecks, so adding vehicles alone does not guarantee more placement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. units.anchor: 鋪蓋延伸與流路~Blanket extension and seepage paths
units.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路~Blanket extension and seepage paths
units.mechanism: 上游防滲鋪蓋可改變進入地基的水頭分布與流路長度，不能只看壩體核心而忽略深部地基。均質一維達西式只是方向性示意，鋪蓋邊緣、分層及局部穿透會產生二維效應；需以孔壓分布和分區流量檢驗。 驗證時應用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，並辨識以下失效情境：鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~An upstream blanket changes foundation entry heads and seepage paths, making foundation control distinct from the core. A uniform one-dimensional Darcy calculation illustrates direction only. Blanket edges, layering and penetrations create two-dimensional effects that require piezometric and zoned-discharge validation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare heads across the blanket and foundation to establish the actual distribution. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 分層導水與各向異性~Layered conductivity and anisotropy
units.title: 分層導水與各向異性~Layered conductivity and anisotropy
units.mechanism: 沖積地基中水平連續砂礫層與低滲夾層可使水平及垂直導水率不同，單一等向係數可能誤判孔壓。平行層等厚加權只適用層內流向，跨層方向需用阻力式；應以鑽探和試驗建立層序與連通性。 驗證時應比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層，並辨識以下失效情境：把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Continuous granular layers and low-permeability seams create directional conductivity. One isotropic value can misrepresent pressures. Thickness-weighted averaging applies to flow parallel to layers, whereas cross-layer flow uses resistance weighting. Boreholes and testing must establish both layer sequence and hydraulic connectivity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 出口梯度與有效重量~Exit gradient and submerged weight
units.title: 出口梯度與有效重量~Exit gradient and submerged weight
units.mechanism: 向上滲流可能減少顆粒骨架有效重量，出口梯度需與土的水下重量和拘束比較。臨界梯度簡式用於均勻無黏性土的浮起尺度，不是所有內部沖蝕的起始門檻；局部集中流與反濾失效可能在其他條件下發生。 驗證時應以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失，並辨識以下失效情境：用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Upward seepage reduces effective skeleton weight. A critical-gradient expression describes heave of uniform cohesionless soil, not the threshold for every internal-erosion mechanism. Concentrated flow and failed retention can develop under other conditions, so check local gradients and filter function separately. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 蓄水分期與孔壓~Impoundment stages and pore pressure
units.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓~Impoundment stages and pore pressure
units.mechanism: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。單一升水步的平均速率不代表可接受操作速度；應按核准程序及失效模式判讀，並辨識尚未達平衡的深層測點。 驗證時應對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，並辨識以下失效情境：只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. Observation periods must fit material and instrument response times. A mean rise rate is descriptive, not an authorized rate; interpret it through approved procedures and failure modes and identify deep points still out of equilibrium. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 三角洲推進與測深~Delta advance and bathymetry
units.title: 三角洲推進與測深~Delta advance and bathymetry
units.mechanism: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。用平均剖面積乘推進距離僅作稜柱近似，沿寬變化和壓密需另處理；應把斷面追蹤、粒徑與輸砂帳連結。 驗證時應沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，並辨識以下失效情境：用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume. Mean cross-sectional area times advance is a prism approximation that omits lateral changes and consolidation. Link repeated sections, grain-size observations and sediment budgets before interpreting long-term progression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 進水口餘隙與淤積~Intake clearance and deposition
units.title: 進水口餘隙與淤積~Intake clearance and deposition
units.mechanism: 既有進水口的底部餘隙會隨沉積與庫水位變化，幾何淨距不足可能提高吸砂與堵塞風險。標高差只提供空間盤點，不預測局部三維取水或再懸浮；需同時觀測底床地形、流速與取水濃度。 驗證時應重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，並辨識以下失效情境：只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Intake clearance changes with deposition and stage, potentially increasing sediment ingestion or blockage. An elevation difference describes geometry, not three-dimensional withdrawal or resuspension. Combine bed surveys, approach velocities and intake concentration to interpret whether the remaining space is hydraulically adequate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Resurvey the intake bed and compare sediment ingestion with local velocity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A distant mean bed level misses a local mound in front of the intake. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 既有隧道擴建損失~Existing tunnel conversion losses
units.title: 既有隧道擴建損失~Existing tunnel conversion losses
units.mechanism: 把既有放水隧道接入新增機組時，流量與壓力邊界改變會影響摩阻和暫態，不能只查隧道直徑是否足夠。局部損失係數乘速度水頭可盤點轉接件作用，還需核對接頭、分岔與下游調節對整體系統的影響。 驗證時應比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形，並辨識以下失效情境：新增轉接損失會降低機組可用淨水頭。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Connecting new generation to an existing release tunnel changes flow and pressure boundaries, affecting friction and transients. Diameter alone is insufficient. A local-loss calculation accounts for one transition, while joints, branching and downstream regulation require a system assessment under the converted operating conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Added connection losses reduce net head available to the generating unit. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 發電用水與放流協調~Generation flow and release coordination
units.title: 發電用水與放流協調~Generation flow and release coordination
units.mechanism: 新增發電功能可能利用原有放流水量，但發電時段與灌溉或下游需求的時間尺度不同。能量算例需清楚定義有效出力與時數，不能把裝置容量全年相乘當保證發電；水量與尾水限制需在共同調度邊界核對。 驗證時應以機組電量表與同期放流水量核對發電時窗，並辨識以下失效情境：把停機或缺水時段也當滿載會高估年度電量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~New generation may use existing releases, but its timing can differ from irrigation or downstream needs. Energy requires defined output and duration; nameplate power times a full year is not guaranteed generation. Reconcile water and tailwater constraints within a common scheduling boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare metered energy with release volumes over the same generating window. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Counting outages or water-limited periods as full output overstates annual energy. units.anchor: 出口消能與修復證據~Outlet dissipation and repair evidence
units.title: 出口消能與修復證據~Outlet dissipation and repair evidence
units.mechanism: 大型低位出口將高水頭轉為高速射流，下游消能與岩床反應必須和洞內壓力一起評估。水力功率給能量速率，不能直接預測沖坑深度；修復前後需以相同流量尾水比較壓力、地形及材料損傷，避免混淆工況改善與構造改善。 驗證時應對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深，並辨識以下失效情境：較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Large low outlets convert head into jets, requiring linked assessment of tunnel pressure, dissipation and the receiving bed. Hydraulic power is an energy rate rather than a scour-depth law. Compare repairs at matching discharge and tailwater using pressures, surveys and damage records to separate operating changes from structural improvement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Match discharge and tailwater before and after repair and compare pool pressure and scour surveys. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Less damage after a smaller flood does not by itself prove a better repair. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

place.name: 塔貝拉水壩公開案例位置~Tarbela Dam public case location

sources.title: 美國墾務局水工手冊與專論目錄
sources.scope: 官方目錄核實 1978 消能工專論、1980 水力試驗技術、1987 小壩設計及1990氣蝕專論；目錄日期不是工程啟用年。
sources.scopeEn: Official catalog verifies the 1978 dissipator monograph, 1980 laboratory techniques, 1987 small-dam manual and 1990 cavitation monograph; publication dates are not project commissioning dates.

sources.title: 巴基斯坦水電開發署塔貝拉壩
sources.scope: 已讀業主頁，核實印度河土石壩與河床以上143m；不將公開高度當教學運轉水頭，也不採變動的容量排名。
sources.scopeEn: Read the owner page verifying the Indus embankment dam and143m above riverbed; public height is not a teaching operating head and changing rankings are excluded.

sources.title: 世界銀行塔貝拉第四擴建資料
sources.titleEn: World Bank Tarbela fourth extension factsheet
sources.scope: 2020年原始計畫頁核實1976年壩完工、灌溉防洪發電用途及2012年第四擴建批准；不採內文相互不符的早期機組加總。
sources.scopeEn: The2020 primary project factsheet verifies1976 dam completion, irrigation/flood/power purposes and2012 fourth-extension approval; inconsistent early unit arithmetic is excluded.

sources.title: 塔貝拉壩計畫原始績效評估
sources.titleEn: Original Tarbela Dam project performance audit
sources.scope: 已檢索1986年原始評估與工程附表，包含深厚地基鋪蓋、低位出口與卡里巴水墊比較；僅作歷史工程脈絡，不移植尺寸。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved indexed sections of the1986 primary audit covering foundation blankets, low outlets and a Kariba pool comparison; used for historical context without transplanting dimensions.

sources.title: 土石壩儀器與監測設計標準
sources.scope: 已讀2014年章節與滲流、孔壓、變形及潛在失效模式監測架構；教學數值另行假設。
sources.scopeEn: Read the 2014 chapter framework for seepage, pore pressure, deformation and potential-failure-mode monitoring; numerical lessons are separately assumed.
